results_applied: three-dimensional product-projection density cap used to obtain M_X,M_Y<=2^(3/2)
rank-three ruled one-sheet theorem C used to isolate the sign-specific two-sheet debt

partner_result_applied.scope_used: sqrt(||d||^2+alpha^2)>beta0*s uniformly through the punctured collar; combined with r40 top-two crossing lower bound

new_results.statement: For independent source banks with orthogonal 3D projections U,V of density caps M_X,M_Y, arbitrary measurable within-bank phases F,G, and invertible 3x3 cross matrix C, Q=F+2U^TCV+G has a bounded continuous density with ||p_Q||_inf<=3(M_X M_Y/|det C|)^(1/3). For cap-one product projections this gives <=6|det C|^(-1/3).
In the account03/B11 r40/r41 collar, every sigma3!=0 obeys ||p_Q||_inf<58.7121947444*s^(-2/3)|sigma3|^(-1/3), because sigma1*sigma2>kappa_*s^2.

After partner r41, any counterexample sequence in the collar must have sigma3->0 while max(||d||,|alpha|)>0.0127849011363*s and sigma1*sigma2>kappa_*s^2; the third curvature cannot disappear geometrically. The one-sheet side is already bounded by pi*sqrt(2).

logarithmic_control: For centered unit uniforms p_{2XY}(t)=log(1/(2|t|)); a nonzero third cross direction changes the crossing Fourier decay from the borderline |t|^-1 to |t|^-3/2, while at sigma3=0 the r38/r39 internal square/bilinear receivers supply an integrated Fourier gain without claiming the rank-two saddle is bounded.
sign_specific_splice: Pinned theorem C gives p_Q(t)<=pi*sqrt(2) on t>=0 for (+,+,-), and on t<=0 for (+,-,-) after negation. The only uniform interpolation debt in the exact-rank-three collar is therefore the opposite two-sheet side.
partner_r40_obstruction_retained: A universal L1_W(L2_v) slice bound is false even for an orthogonal transform of three independent cap-one coordinates; conditioning on the same-bank W is not an admissible replacement for product provenance.
next_step: For the r41 normal form with sigma1*sigma2>=kappa_*s^2 and sqrt(||d||^2+alpha^2)>=beta0*s, combine the internal square/bilinear Fourier sweep with the same-bank sigma3*z*W shear before taking full 3D L2 determinant loss, or force a paid original-coordinate pair/source-disjoint exit. Do not condition on dependent W or perturbatively discard the shear. Additional nonseparable spectrum remains separate.
scope_guard: No moments/support/log-concavity, no post-rotation independence, no arbitrary-joint replacement for product provenance, no extension of one-sheet X-ray control to the two-sheet side, and no small-random-perturbation argument.
